cards.text: It's the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, and the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah the prophet. God sends him to a family called the Rechabites, to bring them into one of the rooms of the house of the LORD and offer them a drink of wine. And baker, this is one of those assignments you read once, read twice, then read a THIRD time just to make sure.

cards.question: God sent the prophet Jeremiah to bring the Rechabites, and he starts with Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah (a different Jeremiah). Who else does the prophet bring?

answers.text: His brothers and all his sons

cards.text: He brings them to the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God, near the officials' room, which sits above the room of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper. That's how I tell somebody where the sprinkles are: by the oven, above the drawer, no, the OTHER drawer.

Jeremiah sets pitchers full of wine and some cups in front of the Rechabite men and tells them, "Drink some wine." They answer, "We do not drink wine," and they bring up their forefather Jonadab son of Rechab.

cards.question: The Rechabites turn down the wine and bring up their forefather Jonadab son of Rechab. Why?

answers.text: He told them never to drink it
He told them to drink only at feasts
He told them to drink only at home

cards.text: And Jonadab didn't stop at wine: "Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard." Forget house rules, baker, these folks don't even GET a house!

cards.question: No houses for the Rechabites. Their forefather Jonadab told them to live in ___ all their lives.
Jonadab's family will wander the land in tents, never planting or building. What reason did he give for these rules?

answers.text: So they could live a long time in the land
So they could always be ready for war
So they could stay far away from kings

cards.text: And the Rechabites say they've obeyed Jonadab in all he commanded them. Meanwhile, I once promised myself I'd stop sneaking chocolate chips, and that lasted ONE batch.

cards.question: True or false: the Rechabites say their wives, sons and daughters haven't drunk wine either.

cards.text: But hold on, these are tent people, and right now they're staying in Jerusalem. Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, has marched into the land.

cards.question: When Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land, why did the tent-dwelling Rechabites go into Jerusalem?

answers.text: To escape the armies coming in
To join the army of Judah
To buy land and finally settle

cards.text: Then the word of the LORD comes to Jeremiah again, and this one is for the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem: "Will you not accept discipline and obey My words?"

cards.question: Now God points Judah to the Rechabites. What does He say about the words their forefather Jonadab gave them?

answers.text: They were too hard to keep

cards.text: Jonadab's sons haven't drunk wine to this very day, because they obeyed their forefather. Not. One. Sip.

cards.question: True or false: God tells the people of Judah that He has spoken to them only once.

cards.text: Again and again, God sent all His servants the prophets to them. That's my oven timer going off TEN times while I stand there asking, "Is something beeping?"

cards.question: What did God's prophets keep telling the people of Judah to do?
God's prophets also warned Judah not to go after other ___ to serve them.

cards.text: Judah hasn't listened, and God sets the two side by side: Jonadab's sons kept their forefather's command, but these people have not listened to Him. It's like getting compared to Steve, the coworker who does everything right, except Steve is a WHOLE FAMILY.

cards.question: So God says He will bring on Judah and all the residents of Jerusalem all the ___ He has announced.

cards.text: Then Jeremiah turns to the Rechabites with a word from the LORD of Hosts: they obeyed Jonadab, kept all his commandments, and did all he charged them to do. Now the spotlight swings over to Steve, and Steve is about to have a GOOD day.

cards.question: Because the Rechabites obeyed their forefather, what does the LORD of Hosts promise the family of Jonadab son of Rechab?

answers.text: A man to stand before God always
Fields and vineyards of their own
